## 2. Repairs Made

### 2.1 Command Palette E2E — Test 7 (1 test)

| Before | After |
|:------|:------|
| ❌ 1 FAIL — palette never closed | ✅ **10/10 PASS** |

**File:** `e2e/command-palette.spec.ts`

**Root cause:** The locator `button:has-text("main")` was unscoped — it matched buttons **anywhere on the page**, not just inside the palette. With `force: true`, it clicked a wrong element and the palette never closed. The fallback Escape key (single press) also didn't work: the CommandPalette clears the search query on first Escape when the query is non-empty, so a single press doesn't close the palette.

**Fix (3 layers):**
1. **Scoped locator:** Changed to `paletteDialog.locator('button:has-text("main")')` using `[aria-label="Command palette — search nodes and actions"]` as the anchor
2. **Removed `force: true`:** No longer needed since we're clicking a visible element inside the palette
3. **Double-Escape fallback:** When no matching nodes exist, press Escape twice — first clears the query, second closes the palette

**Verification:** Full 10-test suite run → 10/10 PASS ✅

### 2.2 Smoke Tests E2E — All 5 Tests (5 tests)

| Before | After |
|:------|:------|
| ❌ 0/5 PASS — all intercepted by onboarding | ✅ **5/5 PASS** |

**File:** `e2e/smoke-tests.spec.ts`

**Root cause:** The Onboarding walkthrough modal renders a full-screen backdrop with `pointer-events-auto` that intercepts all clicks on the underlying UI, including view-switching buttons, zoom controls, and other interactive elements.

**Fix:** Added `suppressOnboarding()` helper using `page.addInitScript` to set `localStorage.setItem('omega_onboarding_completed', 'true')` **before page load**, preventing the onboarding modal from ever rendering. Called in `test.beforeEach` before `page.goto('/en')`. This is the identical pattern used in `omegaFixtures.ts` for all other E2E test suites.

**Verification:** Full 5-test suite run → 5/5 PASS ✅

### 2.3 Rack Features E2E — 3 Failures (3 tests)

| Before | After |
|:------|:------|
| ❌ 3 FAIL (zoom, HUD, overlay) | ✅ **9/9 PASS** |

**File:** `e2e/rack-features.spec.ts`

#### Fix 2.3.1 — HUD Controls (Center View)

**Root cause:** `button[title="Center View"]` matched **2 elements** — one in `ViewportControls.tsx` (bottom-right viewport) and one in `RackMiniMap.tsx` (mini-map). Playwright's strict mode violation.

**Fix:** Added `.first()` — ✅

#### Fix 2.3.2 — Condition 4 Overlay (switchToRackView)

**Root cause:** After `page.goto('/en')` in the Condition 4 test path (following `injectBlueprint` + page reload), the footer Virtual Rack button `footer button[title="Virtual Rack"]` was not available in the DOM within the default timeout. The footer itself was visible, but the rack tab wasn't rendered yet.

**Fix:** Changed `switchToRackView` helper to a try/catch fallback pattern:
1. Try footer button first with 5s timeout
2. Fall back to `Ctrl+2` keyboard shortcut if button not found
3. Added diagnostic console.log for debuggability

#### Fix 2.3.3 — Zoom Test

**Root cause (2 layers):**
1. **Selector too broad:** `.z-50 .font-mono.font-black` matched **10 elements** — `<kbd>` shortcut badges in the viewport controls also have `font-mono font-black` classes
2. **Wheel event unreliable:** `page.mouse.wheel(0, -120)` after `viewport.hover()` in headless Chromium doesn't reliably reach React's `onWheel` handler

**Fix (2 layers):**
1. **Restricted selector:** Changed to `.z-50 span.font-mono.font-black` — `<span>` tag restricts to only the zoom percentage display
2. **Button-based zoom:** Instead of wheel events, click Zoom In (`onZoom(0.1)`) twice and Zoom Out (`onZoom(-0.1)`) once, verifying the percentage display updates correctly (1.0 → 1.2 → 1.1, displayed as 120% → 110%)

**Verification:** Full 9-test suite run → 9/9 PASS ✅

### 2.5 UndoTimelinePopover Keyboard Navigation Enhancement

**File:** `src/features/manifest-editor/components/layout/UndoTimelinePopover.tsx`

**Status:** ✅ Implemented (11 Jest tests updated to match new behavior)

| Feature | Implementation |
|:--------|:--------------|
| **Arrow Down** | Moves focus to next history item |
| **Arrow Up** | Moves focus to previous history item |
| **Home** | Moves focus to first history item |
| **End** | Moves focus to last history item |
| **Focus management** | `tabIndex={0/-1}` pattern — only the focused item is tabbable |
| **Scroll into view** | Auto-scrolls focused item into view with `scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' })` |
| **Mouse hover sync** | Hovering sets `focusedIndex` to match, keeping keyboard+mouse focus in sync |

**Test repair:** The 11 Jest failures were caused by the new `useEffect` using `queueMicrotask` to set `focusedIndex` asynchronously, while the tests expected synchronous tabIndex values.

**Fix:** Replaced `queueMicrotask` with `setTimeout(0)` + `clearTimeout` cleanup in `useEffect` return. Updated tests to use `waitFor` + fake timers (`jest.useFakeTimers()` + `jest.advanceTimersByTime(0)`).

**Result:** ✅ 80/80 tests in UndoTimelinePopover suite passing (was 69/80).

## 5. Key Lessons Learned

### E2E Testing Patterns

| Lesson | Applied in |
|:-------|:-----------|
| **Scoping locators matters:** Unscoped `button:has-text("main")` can match buttons anywhere on the page. Always scope to the relevant container using `aria-label` or `role` selectors. | command-palette fix |
| **Onboarding modal is a silent blocker:** The Onboarding walkthrough renders a full-screen backdrop with `pointer-events-auto` that silently intercepts all clicks. Solution: `page.addInitScript` to set localStorage **before** page load, preventing the modal from rendering at all. | smoke-tests + blueprint-store fixes |
| **Keyboard shortcut fallback for navigation:** When DOM elements aren't available after page reload, keyboard shortcuts (`Ctrl+2` for Virtual Rack) bypass DOM readiness issues and work immediately when the app's shortcut handler is registered. | rack-features Condition 4 fix |
| **`dispatchEvent('wheel', ...)` creates a plain Event, not a WheelEvent:** Playwright's `element.dispatchEvent` creates an Event with only the properties specified, but React's `onWheel` handler uses native wheel events. Best to avoid wheel events in headless and use button-based zoom controls instead. | rack-features zoom fix |
| **Strict mode violations from duplicate elements:** Multiple components may have buttons with the same `title` attribute (e.g., "Center View" in both ViewportControls and RackMiniMap). Use `.first()` or more specific selectors. | rack-features HUD fix |
| **Escape key behavior varies:** CommandPalette clears the query on first Escape when non-empty, and only closes on second Escape. Always verify the actual component's Escape handling logic. | command-palette fix |

### Async Timing in Jest

| Lesson | Applied in |
|:-------|:-----------|
| **`queueMicrotask` in useEffect causes test timing issues:** Tests run synchronously but `queueMicrotask` defers execution. Replace with `setTimeout(0)` + `clearTimeout` cleanup, and use `jest.useFakeTimers()` + `jest.advanceTimersByTime(0)` in tests. | UndoTimelinePopover fix |
